coordinate_conventions.peak_coordinate_system: CellRanger-ATAC BED-like: 0-based half-open start, end exclusive
coordinate_conventions.reconciliation_applied: GTF start converted to 0-based via col4 - 1
coordinate_conventions.tss_definition: gene-level, strand-aware: TSS = gene start on + strand, gene end on - strand

microglial_matrix.definition: det[p] = number of microglial nuclei with at least one fragment in peak p. Derived from ATAC fragments only; no RNA value enters this quantity.

DIRECT_ATAC_ACCESSIBILITY.definition: peak detected in >=1 microglial nucleus and overlapping a TSS within 2 kb
DIRECT_ATAC_ACCESSIBILITY.strength: measured; the ATAC fragments are the measurement

NEAREST_GENE_ANNOTATION.caution: the nearest gene is never the established target

COACCESSIBILITY.reason: No coaccessibility artifact exists in the repository. Stage75C/E/F record no_scenicplus_run=True and no pycisTopic object was ever built, so peak-peak covariation links were never computed.
COACCESSIBILITY.consequence: Distal peak-to-gene assignment therefore rests on proximity alone and stays PROVISIONAL.

INDEPENDENT_ENHANCER_GENE_LINK.reason: No externally validated enhancer-gene link set is present. Without one, no peak-gene assignment in this dataset can be called validated.

motif_support.scope: Motif support was screened only on the 286 cisTarget SCREEN regions reachable from 91 candidate peaks, i.e. 0.0415% of the 219,070-peak universe. It is NOT genome-wide motif evidence.

independent_implementation.note: A second implementation written without the vectorised code path reproduces the nearest-TSS distance. Agreement between two independent routines is the reproducibility evidence.

coordinate_perturbation_control.note: A 50 kb rigid shift must move almost every TSS distance and must reassign a substantial minority of nearest genes. A mapping that survived this shift unchanged would not be measuring position.

stage75c_frozen_table_authentication.note: Stage75C stored gene symbols upper-cased. After case normalisation the frozen assignment is reproduced exactly; the residual difference is tie-breaking among genes at an identical TSS distance, not a different mapping.
